preRegistration.note: The bars below were fixed and committed BEFORE any still was captured. They are reported against verbatim, including where they are missed.

capture.renderer: BLENDER_EEVEE, 512x512, film_transparent, Standard view transform, one fixed sun
capture.cameraDiscipline: One camera transform per pair, computed from lod_0's bounds and REUSED VERBATIM for lod_1, so any difference is the asset and never the framing.
capture.sceneClearing: Object deletion plus orphan purge only. read_factory_settings was never called; the BlenderMCP channel survived all 39 pairs.

headline: THE FALLBACK SET SETTLES THE PALETTE QUESTION AND IT PASSES OUTRIGHT. THE SHED SET MISSES ITS PRE-REGISTERED BAR ON 12 OF 24 PAIRS, and that miss is reported rather than explained away.

result_fallbackPairs.why_this_is_the_decisive_cell: A fallback parent's two levels are the SAME geometry, so geometry is held constant and the ONLY thing that can differ is the material binding. Every one of the 15 renders at a luminance ratio of exactly 1.000000 with a per-channel spread of exactly 0.0 — the two levels are pixel-identical. Before the campaign these same buildings differed by 11-16% in brightness with a 12.3% channel spread. The palette carry-over is confirmed at the one place it can be isolated.

result_shedPairs.direction: lod_1 measures DARKER than lod_0 (mean ratio 0.976), the OPPOSITE sign to the pre-campaign defect, which had lod_1 11-16% BRIGHTER.

postHocDiagnostic.status: POST HOC — designed and computed AFTER the pre-registered numbers were seen. It is a DIAGNOSIS, not a replacement bar, and it does not convert the miss above into a pass.
postHocDiagnostic.measure: Mean over the INTERSECTION silhouette (pixels where BOTH levels have geometry) instead of the union.
postHocDiagnostic.whyItWasAdded: The pre-registered measure averages over the UNION silhouette. A shed level removes protrusions, so the union contains pixels lod_0 fills and lod_1 leaves TRANSPARENT, and those contribute 0 to lod_1's mean. That is a SILHOUETTE-AREA difference being counted as a TONE difference — a flaw in the pre-registered measure, which this record owns rather than hides.

evidence.reading: 2-8% of each shed pair's union area is protrusion pixels present at lod_0 only, which is the right order of magnitude to produce the observed dip.

postHocDiagnostic.residual: EVEN UNDER THE DIAGNOSTIC, 5 of 24 shed pairs remain outside 2%. The diagnostic explains most of the dip; it does not explain all of it, and the remaining 5 are named below rather than absorbed.

result_hueDiagnostic.reading: Every fallback pair has a channel spread of EXACTLY 0.0, which is the clean statement: identical geometry plus identical factors plus a grayscale tile cannot produce a hue difference, and does not. The shed spreads are inflated by the same silhouette-area artifact as the luminance figures, because the removed protrusions are not colour-neutral. This diagnostic is therefore only trustworthy on the fallback cell, where it is unambiguous.

conclusion: The palette carry-over does what the ruling required, and the fallback cell proves it without confound: 15/15 pairs pixel-identical where previously they differed by 11-16%. The shed cell MISSES its pre-registered bar on 12 of 24 pairs. The post-hoc intersection measure attributes most of that miss to the pre-registered measure conflating silhouette area with tone, and recovers 19/24 — but 5 pairs remain unexplained and the pre-registered result stands as a MISS. What the sampling does NOT establish is that every shed lod_1 matches its lod_0 in tone at mid distance; a measure that separates geometry from tone by construction, agreed in advance, is what that would need.
notClaimedHere: This is a comparison between two levels of the SAME release under one renderer, one camera and one light. It is not geographic, architectural, accessibility or performance acceptance.
It does not claim the tile is resolvable at mid ring. Stage 0 measured that it is not, and that finding is unchanged.
The 9 unavailable strata were not sampled and no substitute was rendered for them.
